## About

Lilitha Mdlalana (he/him) is a Software Engineer at Mukuru, based in Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa. He specialises in frontend development with React, TypeScript, and Next.js. He started coding in 2019 and trained at WeThinkCode_.
